map_fields: 25 tiles in row-major order, each unknown fraction then known burning fraction; 50 dimensions
normalization: fixed physical scales, clip shared 72-dimensional context to [-1,1], no train/development/heldout fitting
set_masking: sets padded per minibatch; mean and max exclude padding; empty pools zero; counts/16 and empty indicators; self excluded from teammates
critic: all UAV entities once plus persons/map/summary; no repeated self; one scalar/team-time, no privileged truth
broadcast_assumption: two rounds, reliable synchronous common status/maps/persons then all task actions; ideal simulated exchange, no network delay claim
goal_validity: explore target exists, age<100, not reached within Chebyshev2, its tile has unknown cells; relay ID exists; charge valid; duplicate preserved claims broken by ascending UAV ID
fallback: unknown exhausted: known fire tiles else all tiles, rotate by t//20, no trustworthy timestamps assumed
reward_v2_normalized: same coefficients, divide depletion and switch by number of active UAVs at window start; independent output run
known_limitations: message_bytes measures JSON target-protocol snapshot and task map only; excludes extra raw status history/observation broadcasts and recipient fanout, so it is not complete wire traffic
protection_active is last physical-step task transition override, not a persistent protection latch
task age resets on effective goal changes as well as task changes
no explicit radio packet timestamp/checksum validation beyond common snapshot version, UAV ID set and three-action validity
goal duplicate fallback and no-timestamp fallback are deterministic but not separately counted in episode metrics
frozen movement Actor retains historical input design; new allocator and critic are isolated from truth
full guide acceptance includes further tests and evaluations; contracts.json alone is not overall acceptance
